messages:
elaine-se: Quick sync — Nebulon enterprise pilot: can owners confirm we have an integration-tape window this Friday 4–6pm PT? Need hostnames/IPs + CR approvals. Acceptance criteria: full request->response path <350ms at 1 RPS for the 10k-token pipeline, model pinned to rwd-10k-v1.

sam-engineering: I can own infra/network for the window. Created ticket INF-4821 for VPC peering + firewall rules (ranges + whitelists). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4821 :white_check_mark:

marta-solutions: Adding owners on the customer side — @elaine-se, @sam-engineering, @ryan-qa. Nebulon asked for a dry-run (no traffic) earlier that day (2–3pm). Can we do a quick CR pass before the dry-run?

elaine-se: Yes. CRs: 1) auth flow change (token expiry bump), 2) response wrapper (structured logging). I asked @jules-devex to post the minimal diff.

jules-devex: Pushed PR 3321 — small auth diff and logging keys. TL;DR: bump token TTL from 10m -> 15m, add request_id to logs. Patch snippet:```diff
- TTL=600
+ TTL=900
``` Please review.

ryan-qa: I'll run smoke + latency harness. Need staging creds and the sample prompt set Nebulon provided (set-A). Please drop creds to the secure channel or Hashi vault. My checklist:
- smoke tests pass
- latency <350ms median for 1 RPS
- kv-cache hit rate reported
- no 5xx during 30m soak

sam-engineering: Staging hostnames:
- api-staging.nebulon.internal -> 10.240.12.7
- cache-staging.nebulon.internal -> 10.240.12.8
Added to INF-4821. Also created CR ticket CR-6719 for the auth change.

marta-solutions: Customer-side integration owners confirmed. They'll standby during dry-run and the integration-tape window. Also requested rollback criteria (latency spike >500ms or >1% 5xx).

elaine-se: Good. Two action items before Friday: 1) CR approvals on PR 3321, 2) network whitelists merged. Who can volunteer to do the CR quick pass today?

sam-engineering: I'll do the CR now and leave comments.

ryan-qa: Once CR is merged I can run the dry-run at 2pm. Please drop the staging SSH key to the vault (ryan-qa/staging).

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window: Friday 03:00–05:00 UTC (maps to 8–10pm PT). Note: our automation may block some deploy actions during that time. :warning:

elaine-se: Thanks for the heads-up — that doesn't overlap our 4–6pm PT window, but good to be aware.

jules-devex: I added a short runbook to the PR with rollback commands and the exact curl check we use:```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api-staging.nebulon.internal/generate\" \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' \n  -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":10}'
```

marta-solutions: Perf expectation note for the customer: we will test with 1 RPS and a 10k-token request shape; if they want concurrent higher throughput we'll follow up with Dedicated capacity sizing.

elaine-se: Final: can everyone reply with :thumbsup: once CR + INF-4821 are green? I'll send the calendar invite for the tape + dry-run after that.

sam-engineering: :thumbsup:

ryan-qa: :thumbsup:

jules-devex: :thumbsup:

marta-solutions: :thumbsup:
